Update any automations to use the new `aux_heat_only` switch entity. When this is done, fix this issue and restart Home Assistant.

copy_program.name: Copy program
copy_program.description: Copies comfort settings and/or the weekly schedule from one thermostat to others. Sensors are never copied; each target keeps its own.

comfort_settings.name: Copy comfort settings
comfort_settings.description: Copy climate settings (temperatures, fan, names) matched by climateRef; climates missing on a target are created.

preserve_target_temperatures.name: Preserve target temperatures
preserve_target_temperatures.description: Keep each target's own heat/cool temperatures while copying the other comfort setting fields.

create_vacation.description: Creates a vacation on the selected thermostat. Note: start/end date and time must all be specified together for these parameters to have an effect. If start/end date and time are not specified, the vacation will start immediately and last 14 days (unless deleted earlier).

end_date.description: Date the vacation ends in the YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, 14 days from now if not provided along with 'End time').
end_date.name: End date

end_time.description: Time the vacation ends, in the local time of the thermostat, in the 24-hour format "HH:MM:SS".
end_time.name: End time

entity_id.description: ecobee thermostat on which to create the vacation.
entity_id.name: Entity

fan_min_on_time.description: Minimum number of minutes to run the fan each hour during the vacation.
fan_min_on_time.name: Fan minimum on time

fan_mode.description: Fan mode of the thermostat during the vacation.
fan_mode.name: Fan mode

start_date.description: Date the vacation starts in the YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, immediately if not provided along with 'Start time').
start_date.name: Start date

start_time.description: Time the vacation starts, in the local time of the thermostat, in the 24-hour format "HH:MM:SS".
start_time.name: Start time

vacation_name.description: Name of the vacation to create; must be unique on the thermostat.
vacation_name.name: Vacation name

create_vacation.name: Create vacation

delete_vacation.description: Deletes a vacation on the selected thermostat.

entity_id.description: ecobee thermostat on which to delete the vacation.
entity_id.name: Entity

vacation_name.description: Name of the vacation to delete.
vacation_name.name: [%key:component::ecobee::services::create_vacation::fields::vacation_name::name%]

delete_vacation.name: Delete vacation

get_program.name: Get program
get_program.description: Returns the thermostat program: comfort settings (temperatures in your unit, sensor names) and the weekly schedule in compact form.

resume_all.description: Resume all events and return to the scheduled program.
resume_all.name: Resume all

set_comfort_setting.name: Set comfort setting
set_comfort_setting.description: Changes the heat/cool temperatures and/or participating sensors of one comfort setting (climate) in the thermostat program. The complete program is rewritten.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: ecobee thermostat whose program to change.

climate_ref.name: Comfort setting
climate_ref.description: climateRef (home, away, sleep, smart1, …) or display name of the comfort setting.

heat_temp.name: Heat temperature
heat_temp.description: New heat set point in your Home Assistant temperature unit.

cool_temp.name: Cool temperature
cool_temp.description: New cool set point in your Home Assistant temperature unit.

sensors.name: Sensors
sensors.description: Sensors that participate in this comfort setting, by ecobee sensor name or id (e.g. 'Living Room', 'rs2:100'). Replaces the current list.

set_fan_min_on_time.description: Sets the minimum amount of time that the fan will run per hour.

fan_min_on_time.description: Minimum number of minutes to run the fan each hour.
fan_min_on_time.name: [%key:component::ecobee::services::create_vacation::fields::fan_min_on_time::name%]

set_fan_min_on_time.name: Set fan minimum on time

set_occupancy_modes.description: Enables/disables Smart Home/Away and Follow Me modes.
set_occupancy_modes.name: Set occupancy modes

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces selected days of the weekly program schedule. Days not mentioned are untouched. A day that does not start at 00:00 continues the climate running at the end of the previous day.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: ecobee thermostat(s) whose schedule to change.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Mapping of day key (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun, weekdays, weekend, all) to 'HH:MM climate, HH:MM climate, …'. Times snap to 30 minutes.

set_sensors_used_in_climate.description: Sets the participating sensors for a climate program.

device_ids.description: Sensors to set as participating sensors.
device_ids.name: Sensors

preset_mode.description:
Name of the climate program to set the sensors active on.
Defaults to currently active program.
preset_mode.name: Climate program

set_sensors_used_in_climate.name: Set sensors used in climate
